display_name: WiSig R17 源域实增益固定两倍修正
description: 复用源 U 合规训练的低城区实增益头，将其相对 R17 的复数修正固定乘 2，与原幅度同包比较。
authorization: 当前聊天 01a2204f-647a-7903-ba29-81cfe8f8749b 的融合研发目标及 N607 有显存即启动要求。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32 TF32off; independent CPU scorer

data.representation: 256 complex points, 8 x 32 groups; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head for evaluation only
data.physical_ids_ref: Source V RX4: deterministic seed 2026112901+day choose 100 per day 1/2/3, excluding existing 1800 panel, previous two 300 panels and smoke ID.
data.label_map_ref: Original six classes; no L/U TX label used in training, source V label only after independent freeze
data.train_ratio: 7/63/30; use 52604 U after existing calibration exclusion
data.validation_ref: Reuse existing registered source cache and validated source roles
data.leo_config_ref: Original source full/post_sync/noEQ, 25MHz, 2462MHz, reference SNR 30 dB, reflect boundary, restoration/validation/draw0; clean and practical_low_urban.

permissions.claim_scope: No additional training. Parent weights were fit exclusively on source U and fixed, but chosen after reviewing exposed source V screen. Frozen recognition network only for source V prediction; source V labels read by independent CPU scorer after all two-view predictions freeze.

checkpoint.initialization: Reuse same-contract source U-only 2000-step low-urban spectral gain parent; original R17 and all controls frozen. Candidate changes only fixed output correction factor to 2; parent chosen after source V exposure, not target statistics.

sources.role: WiSig source-only realgain and prior physical-gain candidate as frozen controls; source V RX1 already exposed
Full unroll_unshared R17 E20/4940; source-only TX-free F-free training
WiSig source U-trained PacketUNet parent of realgain
Frozen source U-only 2000-step spectral gain; chosen after RX3 source screen yielded +2 net, below prespecified promotion.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original F0 source roles, existing validation_full IDs, strict source-only frozen checkpoint proofs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No LoRa checkpoints used. WiSig source U-only parents and fixed source-selected R17 have compatible original contract; prior RX1 screen used for development.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 2x factor before viewing this RX4 screen. Require low-urban net >=2 in each deterministic half vs direct, R17, realgain, first fusion and undoubled parent; clean net >=-2 against each. Report paired bootstrap.

execution.gpu_policy: One worker on first GPU with >=8192 MiB free in order 7,2,3,6,1,4,0,5; LoRa GPU5 protected.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on mismatched source parent or U-only proof, nonfinite real-checkpoint no-query smoke, output collision, incomplete predictions or scorer failure. Preserve other owners and outputs.

dimensions: 300 physical records excluding prior 2400 and one smoke

rows.method: Frozen R17 plus twice the frozen source-trained WiSig real spectral gain correction; same parent with undoubled correction included as control.
rows.seed_notes: No new training. Parent training seed 2026112893. Source selector uses model seed + day, halves +3; no support.
rows.budget_ref: No new training; parent 2000 source U-only updates, 48000 exposures on 7517 legal low-urban records; reused frozen checkpoint.

notes: Parent source RX3 screen exposed and informed this 2x hypothesis; source V as a whole historically exposed. Fixed factor before new RX4 screen.
Excludes all earlier 2400 source screen IDs and channel smoke ID 5fa0fd382eb8af0fbc4cc08b.
